title: b7z9.22.5: Root-side beacon slot_map population from DODAG state
description: Implement the root-side logic that computes each node's slot_map and includes it in beacons. Spec R-02a-013: root MUST set slot_map on each beacon. Currently no beacon writer in any language sets slot_map. Design: root assigns slots based on DAO registrations. Python reference implementation first, then port to Rust beacon builder (b7z9.22.1).
